chunk_map.heading: It is not about you being right

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "what this is all about" and L6 "where this all is likely going" are the closest to a vague demonstrative; both are the maintainer's verbatim voice in a first-person guide passage whose subject is the training's own subject, and the guard forbids rewording a quote. L12 "the digest" is the Day 2 digest the trio built earlier in the training (also named on sibling slides). Harm (an unresolvable referent) absent: the header and slide-3-of-3 position carry the subject.
No cross-file pointer by position in body L1-L12; grep 'opening lecture|earlier file|previous lecture' absent by read. Closest: L12 'the digest' names an artefact, not a file position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L12 "the digest agrees with you" is a backward reference to the training's digest; the digest exists in the host training (apt101-read-the-digest, a-faster-feature-factory L6 and analysed-everything-no-insight L4 name it). No 'the X you did/saw' construction on the slide.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-L12: three paragraphs, an attribution and a turn line; the slide carries a self-contained claim (mistakes and acting create the proof; not about being right). Not a wait-state.

L1 header 'It is not about you being right' is the quote's own punchline at L8 and the slide's claim; no content contradicts it. Closest: L12 pivots to 'go looking for your wrong', which extends the header rather than contradicting it.

Closest: L8 'It is not about you being right.' is a single declarative, not a 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' triple; no anaphora triple, superlative, number-plus-retraction ('Not in detail, but I could still see the patterns' L6 is a plain qualifier, no number), abstraction stack or verb triplet. Slide-6 cadence checks by read of L4-L12.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo dialect in L1-L12. Closest: 'digest' (L12) is the trio's own artefact name in APT101, ordinary student vocabulary, not authorial; grep banned/ritual/leverage zero via view.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body L1-L12 = 0 bold (the 5 hits are maintainer-block labels); budget <=1 met.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Slide file inlined by include lines in the host lecture (transparent per curriculum/CLAUDE.md slide-file direction); single ## chunk reaches the deck. No phase-less prose section.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/ship-the-ideas-discover-the-wrongs.md -> 'OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.' exit 0; no hand numbers in header.

rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/ship-the-ideas-discover-the-wrongs.md -> 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links; rule states there is no rule here

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 is a claim ('It is not about you being right'), the lecture-heading form, on a lecture slide; no instruction-mood mismatch.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 'It is not about you being right.' repeats the header (16c shape). Stays inside: it is the pull-quote's own close, the attribution at L10 binds to it, and the header is lifted from it by design under the quote-only guard; L12 is the one new turn the training owes. No doctrine restatement or design commentary. Cutting L8 would strip the quote of its ending.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Header changed in the pinned diff (8b8f4070..HEAD, 'Being wrong does not diminish you' -> 'It is not about you being right') and the body was rewritten with it: L4-L8 answer the new header, none of the old 'Lack of effort to understand' bullets remain.
